CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION move_old_annual_returns(p_years_to_keep integer)
RETURNS void AS $$
BEGIN
  -- Create the archive table if it doesn't exist
  CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS annual_returns_archive (
    yearlyid bigint,
    portfolioref character varying,
    calendaryear bigint,
    fundperf real,
    categoryperf real
  );

  -- Move old records into the archive
  INSERT INTO annual_returns_archive (yearlyid, portfolioref, calendaryear, fundperf, categoryperf)
  SELECT yearlyid, portfolioref, calendaryear, fundperf, categoryperf
  FROM annual_returns
  WHERE calendaryear < (EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE)::bigint - p_years_to_keep);

  -- Delete the moved records from the original table
  DELETE FROM annual_returns
  WHERE calendaryear < (EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE)::bigint - p_years_to_keep);
END;
$$ LANGUAGE plpgsql;
